summary: Premium homepage landing intro: 6/6 acceptance criteria covered with 6 new browser checks, all passed. No backend-bearing criteria in this matrix.

checks.criterion: Premium homepage intro plays on first visit
checks.name: intro-plays-on-first-visit
checks.evidence: With switchyard-intro-seen cleared, navigating to / showed landing-intro with landing-intro-mark='S', landing-intro-brand='SwitchYard', landing-intro-tagline='Clarity in motion'; intro became hidden (exited) within 3s, revealing the hero.

checks.criterion: Intro plays only once per browser session
checks.name: intro-plays-only-once-per-session
checks.evidence: After first intro completed and hid, a full page reload rendered zero landing-intro elements; navigating to /about then back to / also rendered zero landing-intro elements, confirming sessionStorage persistence across reload and in-SPA navigation.

checks.criterion: Intro is scoped to the homepage
checks.name: intro-scoped-to-homepage-only
checks.evidence: With switchyard-intro-seen cleared each time, direct goto of /about, /services, /insights, /contact, /login each rendered zero landing-intro elements.

checks.name: intro-reduced-motion-bypass
checks.evidence: With emulateMedia reducedMotion='reduce' and session key cleared, / rendered zero landing-intro elements immediately, site-shell/hero visible instantly, and document.body.style.overflow was not locked ('' / 'visible').

checks.criterion: Intro exit leaves the live homepage fully usable
checks.name: intro-exit-leaves-homepage-usable
checks.evidence: After intro hid, body.style.overflow restored to default, hero-market-source badge read 'LIVE · TWELVE DATA', page remained interactive through a scroll, and zero non-benign console/page errors plus zero failed /api requests were captured (the one benign 'sessionStorage sandboxed' harness message was filtered as pre-existing automation-sandbox noise seen identically on unrelated pre-existing checks, not an app defect).

checks.name: intro-responsive-at-375px
checks.evidence: At 375x812, landing-intro-mark/brand/tagline all visible and fully within the 0-375px horizontal bounds, documentElement.scrollWidth <= 377 during the intro; after exit the hero also stayed within scrollWidth <= 377, confirming no horizontal overflow before or after exit.

notes.note: A benign pageerror 'Failed to read the sessionStorage property from Window: sandboxed and lacks allow-same-origin' appears consistently across every check in this automation harness (including unrelated, pre-existing checks run previously), indicating it originates from the test runner's iframe sandboxing rather than the SwitchYard app. It was excluded from the console-error assertion in intro-exit-leaves-homepage-usable accordingly and did not block any assertion elsewhere since the app's own sessionStorage usage (verified functionally via once-per-session behavior) still worked correctly.
